notes: The universe remains degenerate in the ways integration round 2 recorded, and w107 closes none of them. Two measured findings worth reading beside this gate. First, the v1 rectangle cannot make food: of the 59 authored resource-yield effects at target universe, exactly five sit in a v1 cell and all five route to stone, because terram is the only material-bearing form among the twelve. Every ruleset comparison taken inside the v1 rectangle is therefore an argument about stone. Second, stated carefully because the sloppy version has misled several readers: advanceConstruction and applyLibraryUpkeep both have production callers in world-step.ts and run every tick, so construction is NOT inert. What is measured over 1200 ticks of the reference universe with zero god actions is constructionStoneOwed 0, buildProgressAdded 0, universitiesCompleted 0, against exactly one university -- the seeded academy, already complete. Founding a site is a god action, so with no actions submitted there is nothing to advance and stone is never spent. Those two facts together are why the campaign-plan W90 measurement of a yield-maximising ruleset was null by construction of its arms rather than for want of a mechanism: the arms could only make stone, and stone had nothing to buy.

rationale: PR #126 (w109/alliances) ships god action 16, `invite scholar`, as a seventeenth record in packages/content/data/god-cost.json. provenance.contentHash moves e8442af2c5f91ae6f80ad9a178e0e451 -> 0dfdd5efc2c6dad07bd486a7d80c851d, so this gate refuses on provenance before it reads a metric -- 'the gate compares two runs of one build; across two builds a delta is not a regression, it is a category error'. Recorded from the tree MERGED WITH origin/main 552630b, not from the branch alone, per the w77 precedent that a competing baseline re-record means taking the measurement from the merged tree. THIS FILE IS A MEASUREMENT, NOT A BALANCE CLAIM: release-plan.md forbids a balance claim before 0.5.0 and nothing here is one. THIS FILE (the five-year gate, worldTickCap 60, 200 runs, 9 metrics): ALL 9 OF 9 ROWS MOVED BY EXACTLY 0.00000 against the superseded baseline -- not 'passed', moved by zero. BYTE-IDENTITY IS ESTABLISHED BY GREPPING FOR NON-ZERO DELTAS, NOT BY READING THE PASS COLUMN, and the grep was given a positive control: run against #161's own agency recording the same grep finds its 19 movers (the 9 pooled aggregates plus all 10 @permissive-breadth rows), so a checker that reports zero here is a checker that can report non-zero. Across all three gates the count is 109 of 109 rows at 0.00000 (9 + 10 + 90). WHAT THIS RE-DERIVES: earlier passes on this branch established 109/109 at zero against main at 8d2159f and 90/90 at zero on the agency gate after #125 landed underneath. Whether alliances still moves nothing WITH ANTI-REQUISITES IN THE BASE was a genuine question -- anti-requisites removes cells a mage may hold and alliances buys a foreign scholar, so an interaction was plausible -- and the answer measured here is that it does not. THE STRUCTURAL REASON, unchanged by the merge: action 16 needs portal magic and a species with no living mage, and these three sweeps play the v1 rectangle with a fixed passive-control or round-robin pool that never reaches the portal chain, so the verb is never legal. The exclusion pair is invisible to these sweeps for its own separate reason (both halves are creo; the v1 rectangle is intellego/perdo/rego x mentem/terram/limen/nomen). NO GOLDEN FIXTURE WAS REGENERATED and none needed to be.
